- error_pct >5% for 5m
- dns_failures >=1 in same window

deploy-bot: Scheduled apply for 22:10 UTC (canary FRA). To abort: comment "abort-apply" in the PR or run `/deploybot cancel 5032109876`. Will post plan summary to the PR.

ben: Escape hatch notes:
1) If route propagation >10m: run `terraform state rollback --to=sha:prev` then re-run plan.
2) If IAM assume-role errors: revoke new role via console and revert the commit.
Docs: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/iam-rollback

carla: Confirmed staging smoke passed. I'll be on call from 21:50-23:30 UTC.
